plan.headline: Prioritize the entry due today, then follow each entry’s assigned route. Entries described as eligible only appear eligible; confirm the filings and deadlines with your customs broker. This is not legal advice.

steps.title: File the CAPE claim due today
steps.detail: Ask your broker to submit this entry through CAPE today; it appears eligible for filing, but a refund is not guaranteed.

steps.title: File the next CAPE claim
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file this entry through CAPE before the deadline; it appears eligible for filing.

steps.title: Submit a protest
steps.detail: Ask your broker about filing a protest, a formal challenge, by the deadline; this entry is not eligible for CAPE under the rules engine results.

steps.title: Correct the entry, then file in CAPE
steps.detail: Ask your broker to move the goods value from the Chapter 99 line to the Chapter 1–97 line, then file through CAPE before the deadline.

steps.title: Submit the next protest
steps.detail: Ask your broker about filing a protest by the deadline; this entry is not eligible for CAPE under the rules engine results.

steps.title: File the next CAPE claim
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file this entry through CAPE before the deadline; it appears eligible for filing.

steps.title: Submit the final dated protest
steps.detail: Ask your broker about filing a protest by the deadline; this entry is not eligible for CAPE under the rules engine results.

steps.title: File the remaining CAPE claim
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file this entry through CAPE; it appears eligible, and the rules engine lists no deadline.

steps.title: Get the entry summary, confirm the amount, then file
steps.detail: Ask your broker for the entry summary to verify the IEEPA duty amount, then file through CAPE if confirmed; the rules engine lists no deadline.

steps.title: Ask your broker about the surety-paid entry
steps.detail: CBP says not to file a CAPE declaration for this entry because a surety paid the IEEPA duties; ask your broker what to do next.

steps.title: Check the entries awaiting a court outcome
steps.detail: There is no refund order yet for these class-member entries. Confirm their status with your broker and consider asking a customs attorney about options for a large balance.

steps.title: No refund action indicated
steps.detail: The rules engine says no IEEPA duty was paid on this entry, so there is nothing to refund for it.

plan.broker_email_subject: Help with Lotus Tile & Stone LLC IEEPA refund entries
plan.broker_email_body:
Hello,

Please review the entries below and help us take the action shown in the rules engine results. Please confirm the routes and deadlines, and let us know once any filings or corrections are complete.

• File through CAPE: HP7-0414106-2 by Oct 24, 2026; HP7-0414533-5 by Nov 16, 2026; HP7-0415250-8 by Dec 21, 2026; and HP7-0415702-7 (no deadline listed).
• Protest: HP7-0413540-6 by Nov 22, 2026; HP7-0413822-4 by Dec 12, 2026; and HP7-0414117-9 by Jan 31, 2027.
• Correct, then file through CAPE: HP7-0414879-0. Please move the goods value from the Chapter 99 line to the Chapter 1–97 line before filing, by Nov 30, 2026.
• Confirm the amount, then file through CAPE: HP7-0416475-1. Please send us the entry summary so the IEEPA duty amount can be checked.
• HP7-0416018-4: the results say a surety paid the IEEPA duties and not to file a CAPE declaration. Please advise what action, if any, is appropriate.
• HP7-0412207-3 and HP7-0412988-1: please confirm their status while a court refund order is pending.
• HP7-0411873-2: the results indicate no IEEPA duty was paid.

Please confirm the timing and next steps with us. We understand that entries appearing eligible do not guarantee a refund.

[Your name]
Lotus Tile & Stone LLC
